D01: SYS-WDG-001  The independent watchdog timeout is unspecified as a suitable timeout instead of the required 100 ms.
D02: SYS-MEM-007  The phrase 'a small share' is not verifiable and omits the required limit of 0.5 ms per control cycle.
D03: SYS-DIAG-013  The maximum request length is left as TBD even though the product decision specifies 32 ASCII characters.
D04: SYS-DIAG-001  The specified 9600 baud conflicts with the required 115200 baud and undermines the specified diagnostic transmission timing.
D05: SYS-PERF-001  The 25% processor-time limit conflicts with the stakeholder maximum of 10%.
D06: SYS-WDG-002  The specified 2 ms to 40 ms window conflicts with the required 6 ms to 12 ms window.
D08: SYS-RST-002  Storing every reset cause in the fault history introduces non-fault entries into a history specified to contain fault reports.
D09: SYS-SAFE-009  Requiring the latch never to be lost under any circumstances conflicts with the requirement to clear it on power-on reset.
D11: SYS-MEM-006  The 50 ms full-pass deadline conflicts with the required 11 s deadline and cannot be met by processing one 1 KiB segment per 10 ms cycle for a 1 MiB image.
D14: SYS-SAFE-007  The latch threshold of five detections conflicts with the required third detection of the same fault code.
D16: SYS-TEST-002  The requirement cites STK-SUP-016, which does not exist in the stakeholder needs.
D17: SYS-DIAG-003  The report deadline omits its time unit and therefore does not specify the required 10 ms limit.
D18: SYS-DIAG-019  AES-128 encryption is unsupported by the inputs and conflicts with the specified plaintext fault-report format.
D19: SYS-SUP-011  The requirement invents a specific function and SysTick interrupt implementation that the stakeholder inputs do not establish.
D21: SET  The set does not require detection of a configuration integrity fault with code 6 and entity CONFIG when the start-up configuration CRC comparison fails.
SYS-MEM-002  The configuration CRC requirement omits the specified __cfg_start and __cfg_end boundaries and the separate __cfg_crc reference location outside the checked range.
D22: SET  The set does not require a line longer than 32 characters to receive an ERR response when no earlier answer is being transmitted.
SYS-DIAG-015  The requirement references SYS-DIAG-014, which is absent from the requirement set.
D23: SYS-SAFE-030  Requiring a software reset after a configuration fault conflicts with the immediate latched safe state and the prohibition on requesting a reset in SYS-SAFE-014.
